name: Twin Sunbeam
description: Cast a sunbeam from each palm so the two rays cross on the target and burn where they meet.

name: Sunpaired Fist
description: Throw a fist wreathed in a small sun and follow at once with the second in the same line.

name: Reflected Gleam
description: Hold two mirrored discs of light that catch an incoming flame or ray and return it along its path.

name: Pairsun Sense
description: Hold both suns up and read the strength of two foes at once from the warmth they return.

name: Paired Corona
description: Set one glowing rim before the body and one behind so that no blow from front or back gets through.

name: Twin Sunlash
description: Lash two cords of bright fire round the arms of an opponent and pin them to the sides.

name: Twinmend Glow
description: Pour the two suns into two hurts of an ally or the self and mend them together.

name: Binary Flare
description: Fire both suns into the ground ahead so they burst as one great flare that scorches the whole front.

name: Solar Pairing
description: Bind the user and one ally under the two suns so each draws strength from the other's warmth.

name: Binary Corona
description: Bring both full suns together and let their joined rim burst outward in a great ring that burns everything it crosses.

name: Dawnglow Touch
description: Lay a hand warm with the light of first morning on a hurt of an ally or the self and ease it.

name: Golden Current
description: Run a slow gold current of qi along a wounded limb of an ally or the self and mend it from end to end.

name: Dawn Ray
description: Throw a pale gold ray low along the ground that rises to sting at the knee.

name: Dawn Ward
description: Raise a soft golden ward before an ally to turn aside a clumsy blow.

name: Dawnsense
description: Spread a pale light along the current and note which of the wounded it warms and which it passes.

name: Golden Purge
description: Wash the gilded current through the veins of a poisoned ally or the self to carry the taint out.

name: Dawn Torrent
description: Pour a hard torrent of dawn-gold light along the other bank of the current onto the foe.

name: Gilded Rouse
description: Run the gilded current through a tired ally and wake every worn muscle.

name: Daybreak Tide
description: Raise a rising tide of golden light that closes wounds across all the allies gathered round the user.

name: Gilded Revival
description: Send the full gilded current into the chest of an ally who has just died and call the first breath back.

name: Sunlit Deluge
description: Break the bank of the current and let a flood of white-gold light roll over a whole company of foes.

name: Sunstore Draw
description: Draw the day's light into the body and store it in the belly like water in a basin.

name: Stored Warmth
description: Spend a little of the stored light to warm and close a hurt of an ally or the self.

name: Daystar Fist
description: Throw a fist backed by a measure of the stored light so it lands heavy and hot.

name: Sunbrim Fist
description: Spend a full measure through the knuckles in one blow that bursts and burns on the target.

name: Overflow Mend
description: Let the overflow of the stored light run into a deep wound of an ally or the self.

name: Sunstore Guard
description: Pour stored light out in a ring about the body that turns blows for as long as the store lasts.

name: Sunstore Release
description: Let the whole store go in a single blast that burns the ground in a wide circle round the user.

name: Daystar Rush
description: Pour a large part of the store into an ally so the ally leaps up at full strength.

name: Overflowing Sun
description: Fill the body past the brim and let the whole sun spill from the fist in a single burning blow.

name: Hawkeye Gleam
description: Pick a bright point on the target from far off and hold its warmth in the mind.

name: Zenith Swoop
description: Spring up on a pillar of light and swoop down at an angle to land beside the target.

name: Talon Ray
description: Cast a hooked ray that rakes the arm of an opponent as it passes.

name: Dive Flash
description: Fall onto an opponent in a burst of white light with a heel or a hand.

name: Highsun Pounce
description: Pounce from the full glare of the sun so the opponent sees only light and then feels the blow.

name: Zenith Glide
description: Hold a long glide on warm rising air of qi across an open space.

name: Zenith Brand
description: Throw a mark of white fire from above that sticks to an opponent and draws the next blow.

name: Plummeting Sun
description: Drop a small sun from a great height onto the chosen target so it lands with the weight of a falling stone.

name: Piercing Zenith
description: Drive a needle of noon light straight down through plate and bone in one pass.

name: Sunflash Dive
description: Vanish in a flash of noon light and reappear above the target already falling to strike.

name: Corona Pulse
description: Pulse the pale rim of fire outward in a thin ring that scorches those within arm's reach.

name: Rim Light
description: Draw a bright rim round the body that takes a hit on its edge.

name: Coronal Sense
description: Read the pull on the rim to tell which way a hidden foe is leaning.

name: Corona Palm
description: Strike with a palm edged in the rim so the blow burns at its outer ring.

name: Halo Warmth
description: Rest the rim round the head and chest of an ally and let its warmth ease the hurt inside.

name: Corona Wheel
description: Spin the rim into a wheel of fire that cuts and burns the ground about the user.

name: Outer Corona
description: Hold a second wider rim outside the first so a blow must pass two layers of fire.

name: Corona Mending
description: Draw the rim over a wounded ally like a cloak and let it mend the flesh beneath.

name: Corona Lash
description: Whip a loop of the rim round an opponent and cinch it tight.

name: Corona Burst
description: Let the rim swell and burst in a great wave of heat round the user.

name: Crowned Warmth
description: Set a crown of soft fire on each ally in reach and fill their limbs with its steady heat.

name: Full Corona
description: Spread the whole rim wide and drink the force of every blow that strikes it into the glow.

name: Noonbreath
description: Breathe in the high sun and push the heat to the extremities of the user.

name: Highsun Fist
description: Hit square with a fist that drives forward against any pressure that meets it.

name: Brightwind Step
description: Step into a gust and let it carry a streak of light ahead of the user.

name: Noonward Guard
description: Set a bright guard on the windward arm that does not give before a hard push.

name: Highsun Lash
description: Crack a whip of white heat across the guard of an opponent and leave a welt.

name: Clear Noon Purge
description: Burn a curse or a binding away from an ally in the full glare of noon.

name: Noonbright Draw
description: Flash so bright the casters near the user lose their grip on their qi for a breath.

name: Noonfire Arc
description: Swing an arc of high-sun fire across the whole front and burn away every cover.

name: Noon Revival
description: Stand over a fallen ally in the full sun and drive the light into the chest to call the breath back.

name: Windward Zenith
description: Hurl the sun at its height straight against the wind so it cuts through all that stands before it.

name: Anchor Warmth
description: Sink a sworn warmth into the hurt of a companion and hold it there until it eases.

name: Vow Flash
description: Flash a sworn fist at the one who threatens a companion.

name: Oathlight Ward
description: Throw up the oath as a ward of white light before the companion.

name: Anchored Sense
description: Tie the senses to a companion and feel at once when their strength starts to fall.

name: Sworn Sunbeam
description: Cast a sworn beam at the one pressing a companion.

name: Oathburn Purge
description: Burn the poison from a companion with the full weight of the oath behind the heat.

name: Vowed Mending
description: Hold the oath through a long mending of a deep wound in a companion.

name: Sunbound Rouse
description: Bind the courage of a companion to the sun so it does not fail.

name: Anchor Brand
description: Brand the oath-breaker with a mark of fire that holds the foe in place.

name: Anchored Revival
description: Anchor a dying companion to the world with the full oath and call the life back into the body.

name: Sunsworn Bulwark
description: Raise a great sworn guard of sun light over the companions behind the user.

name: Anchored Dawnfire
description: Strike the oath-breaker with a blow of dawn fire that cannot be turned aside lightly.

name: Sunsworn Verdict
description: Bring down the whole of the oath as one stroke of sun fire upon the one who broke faith.

name: Skyglow Sense
description: Read the whole bright sky for any shape moving across it.

name: Radiance Spill
description: Let a bright sheet fall across the ground and scorch the unwary.

name: Brightsun Palm
description: Open a palm full of light into the face of an opponent.

name: Skybright Ward
description: Hold up a sky-wide ward of light that turns blows from any angle.

name: Skyspread Ray
description: Spread a ray across the sky so it falls on many foes at once.

name: Clear Radiance
description: Wash clean light over allies to lift taint and shadow from their bodies.

name: Skyfire Rain
description: Call drops of sun fire down from the open sky to rain on a wide field.

name: Radiance Rouse
description: Pour open radiance over the allies in the field so the weary stand taller.

name: Blinding Zenith
description: Burst a glare from the sky's height so complete that foes in sight lose all sense of direction.

name: Bearing Ray
description: Fix a bearing on the target and send a ray along it in a straight line.

name: Fixed Gleam
description: Hold a steady gleam on one point and judge its distance by the return.

name: Truesun Dart
description: Throw a dart of light that follows the bearing and does not drift.

name: Compass Glow
description: Let the glow lean toward the nearest ally in need.

name: Bearing Ward
description: Hold a ward set on the same bearing as the foe's blow so it meets the blow squarely.

name: Seeking Beam
description: Guide a beam round obstacles by small turns until it lands on the target.

name: Homing Flare
description: Launch a flare that bends toward the warmest body in front of it.

name: Bearing Mend
description: Send a mending ray along a held bearing to an ally across the field.

name: Unerring Sunbeam
description: Cast a great beam on a true bearing that pierces whatever stands in its line.

name: Tracking Radiance
description: Hold the glow on a fleeing opponent so that it clings and drags the steps.

name: Unswerving Sun
description: Cast the sun itself along the bearing so that nothing deflects it or stops it short.

name: Zenith Spill
description: Let the noon glare spill out on all sides of the user.

name: Wideglow Ward
description: Hold a wide ward that covers the user and the ground at the sides.

name: Open Zenith Sense
description: Open the senses to the full height of the sky and the breadth of the ground.

name: Boundless Flick
description: Flick light out beyond what the eye can follow to touch a far target.

name: Zenith Cleanse
description: Burn foul qi and taint out of every ally standing in the open light.

name: Spreading Fire
description: Spread a low fire over open ground until every foe in it is scorched.

name: Open Sun Mending
description: Heal all wounded allies in the open at the same slow pace.

name: Boundless Zenith
description: Raise the zenith over the whole field and burn all that moves within it.

name: Limitless Rouse
description: Fill the field with a limitless warmth that keeps every ally upright.

name: Unwalled Noonfire
description: Let the unwalled sun fall on all the field and sky and leave nothing standing in it.
